newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zimbabwe key share index tumbles on blue chips.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabwe key share index tumbles on blue chips.

text.p: Zimbabwe's key share index tumbled 51.80 points to 10,320.89 on Tuesday in a market where losers outnumbered gainers by 18 to six, but which brokers expect to trade generally balanced during the week.

The 59-counter industrial index was driven down largely by falls in bluechips conglomerate Zimbabwe Newspapers, sugar producer Hippo Valley and hotel and supermarkets chain Meikles, which lost 300 cents to 5,000, 50 cents each to 1,400 and to 2,600 respectively.
"There was a bit of profit-taking here and there, but for the week it's still looking fairly balanced," one broker said.
The secondary seven-share mining index climbed 3.74 points to 993.30 after a 50-cent rise in gold miners Rio Tinto to 2,650.
